title: Train strike tomorrow
instructions: Radyo haberlerinde tren grevi duyuruluyor. Hatları, saatleri ve alternatifleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: host
script.text: And now some travel news. There will be a train strike tomorrow, Tuesday, from six a.m. to eight p.m.

script.speaker: host
script.text: There will be no trains on the north and east lines.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Trains on the south line will run, but only one every hour, not every fifteen minutes.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Extra buses will run between the main stations, but they will be very busy.

script.speaker: host
script.text: If you can, please work from home or travel after eight in the evening.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Tickets for tomorrow can be used on Wednesday instead.

questions.evidence: There will be a train strike tomorrow, Tuesday

questions.prompt: Which lines will have no trains?
questions.feedback: Kuzey ve doğu hatlarında hiç tren olmayacak.
questions.evidence: There will be no trains on the north and east lines.

questions.prompt: How often will trains run on the south line?
questions.feedback: Güney hattında on beş dakikada bir değil, saatte bir.
questions.evidence: but only one every hour, not every fifteen minutes.

options: work from home or travel after eight p.m.
